scripts.build: mvn clean install -pl packages/maven/analyzer-plugin -DskipTests && nx build @nx/maven
scripts.test: pnpm reset && echo RUNNING && nx run-many -t verify --verbose --parallel 12
scripts.reset: nx reset && pnpm build:plugin && pnpm build
scripts.clean: ./mvnw clean && rm -rf ~/.m2/repository && nx reset && echo 'Cleaned: Maven targets, local repository (~/.m2/repository), and Nx cache'
scripts.release: pnpm release:version && pnpm nx run nx-maven-plugin:sync-maven-version && git add packages/maven/analyzer-plugin/pom.xml && git commit --amend --no-edit
scripts.release:local: pnpm build && nx release version prerelease && nx release publish
